skylyn-drive-arp-spartanburg-sc.assessment: Skylyn Drive ARP Church is an Associate Reformed Presbyterian congregation in Spartanburg, South Carolina, led by Rev. Matthew Richardson. His training follows the classic ARP pipeline: B.A. from Erskine College (the ARP-affiliated college in Due West) in 1995, M.Div. from Reformed Theological Seminary in 1998, and ordination in the ARP Church in January 2000. The church maintains a traditional weekly rhythm: Sunday School 10 AM, Worship 11 AM, Wednesday Potluck & Bible Study 6:30 PM. ARP male-only ordination and Westminster Standards align with MOOP's biblical-design rubric. Solid green-rated option for the Spartanburg area.
